confirm_stop_title: Stop every program in your stack?
confirm_stop_prose: Downloads stop where they are, whatever they were serving goes offline, and anyone watching is cut off. Nothing is deleted, and starting it again brings all of it back.
work_under_way: lemonfiber took this on and runs it apart from this page, so closing the tab would not stop it. It is called {job}, and this page keeps asking what became of it.
work_done: lemonfiber finished this while you waited, and said what it came to.
action_pull_chosen: Fetch newer versions of what you chose
action_seed: Wire your programs to each other
doing_seed_title: Wiring your programs to each other
work_finished: lemonfiber finished {job}, and said what it came to.
work_forgotten: This run has no work called {job} any more. Either it was never handed out, or lemonfiber has been restarted since — nothing carries a job across a restart.
work_adrift: This page could not ask what became of {job}. {said}
came_rehearsed: This was a rehearsal, so nothing was changed.
came_exit: Compose ended with status {status}, where 0 means everything went through.
came_condition_active: Everything it expected is up and answering.
came_condition_partial: Some of the services are up and others are not.
came_condition_degraded: The services are running, and at least one of them wants attention.
came_condition_unknown: lemonfiber said how the services stand in a word this page does not know.
came_stopped: Stopped, because what you chose does not hold them: {names}.
came_kept: Left running, because what you chose holds them too: {names}.
came_port_held: Port {port} is already answered by {holder}, and {wanter} wants it too.
came_edited: {path} was changed by hand, and was left as it was set rather than overwritten.
came_unassessable: The record of what lemonfiber wrote is missing, so a change made by hand could not be told apart from its own.
came_wiring_conflicted: {connection} was set by hand to {yours}, where lemonfiber would write {ours}. It was left as it was set.
came_wiring_drifted: Changed by hand, and kept as they are: {connections}.
came_wiring_stale: Behind what lemonfiber would write now, and left alone until they are brought up to date: {connections}.
came_wiring_would_adopt: A real run would keep these as they were set by hand: {connections}.
came_wiring_observed: {connection} was left alone, because you said lemonfiber is not to manage it: {reason}
came_wiring_skipped: {connection} was not wired yet, and a later run will finish it: {reason}
came_wiring_failed: {connection} was tried and refused. The service said: {detail}
came_wiring_refused: {connection} was not wired, and running it again will not change that: {reason}
came_wiring_unmatched: {connection} was not wired, because nothing lemonfiber does connects these two: {reason}
came_wiring_adopted: Kept as they were set by hand: {connections}.
came_wiring_unmanaged: Set before lemonfiber was, and taken as they are: {connections}.
came_wiring_other: Turned out in a way this page has no words for: {connections}.
came_unread: lemonfiber said what this came to in a form this page does not read yet.
came_checks_shown: What each check found is listed on this screen.
came_repair_offered: Could be put right, and nothing has changed yet: {check}. {does}
came_repair_fixed: Put right, and the check agrees: {check}.
came_repair_fix_failed: Tried, and the check still fails: {check}.
came_repair_declined: Left alone, because it was not chosen: {check}.
came_repair_would_overwrite: Left alone, because it would overwrite a change made by hand: {check}.
came_repair_unmanaged: Left alone, because you said lemonfiber is not to manage it: {check}.
came_repair_unknown: Turned out in a way this page has no words for: {check}.
came_repair_beyond: Tried too often to keep offering: {check}. {action}
came_repair_nothing: There was nothing to put right.
came_undo_nothing: There was nothing to put back.
came_undo_remove: what it added was taken away
came_undo_restore: a setting has its old value again
came_undo_delete: a file it wrote was removed
came_undo_withdraw: what it wrote into a file was taken out
came_undo_repin: the version before it is back
came_undo_reconfigure: a field has its old value again
came_undo_rewind: a file it wrote over holds its old text again
came_undo_revoke: the key it minted was revoked
came_undo_reinstate: a revoked key was made good again
came_undo_other: something this page has no words for was put back
action_offer_repairs: See what lemonfiber can put right
action_diagnose: Run the checks that disturb a running stack
confirm_diagnose_title: Run the checks that disturb a running stack?
confirm_diagnose_prose: They take the tunnel away for a moment to prove downloading stops without it, and spend one real search against the places things are found. Everything comes back when they finish.
confirm_accept_prose: The warning stays on the list, set aside, and stops asking for you. Nothing about the stack changes.
confirm_undo_prose: lemonfiber reverses what its last repair changed wherever it still holds what the repair wrote, and says what it could not put back.
doing_repair_title: Putting right what the checks found
came_scope_existing: the setup that was already here, {project}
came_scope_other: a part of the stack this page has no words for
came_sensitive: It holds passwords and keys, so keep it somewhere only you can reach.
came_backup_pruned: Older backups removed to keep within the number kept: {names}
came_backup_slow: It moved {moved}, more than the {budget} a backup is meant to stay within, so the next one may take a while.
came_restore_would: It holds {scope}, taken at {taken} by lemonfiber {version}. Nothing has been put back yet.
came_restore_relocation: It was taken where lemonfiber kept its data at {was}, and this machine keeps it at {now}.
came_restore_downgrade: It was written by an older lemonfiber, so some settings may read differently now.
came_restore_done: Put back {scope}, from a backup written by lemonfiber {version}.
came_restore_repointed: What pointed at {was} now points at {now}.
came_bundle_would: It would be written to {path}, {size}. Nothing has been written yet.
came_bundle_filenames_shown: Media filenames are shown as they are.
came_bundle_filenames_replaced: Media filenames are replaced by marks.
confirm_backup_title: Take a backup of your whole stack?
confirm_backup_prose: lemonfiber writes an archive of every program's settings, its own settings and the stack, and none of your media. It takes one only while the stack is stopped, and says so if it is running. Older backups beyond the number it keeps are removed.
action_restore_listing: See what putting back {archive} would do
action_support_describe: See what a bundle would hold
came_quality_reapplied: The recorded preset is in force again, over what was edited by hand.
came_quality_would_reapply: The recorded preset would be put back, and nothing has changed yet.
came_quality_held: The choice is held, because this machine would have to transcode it in software.
came_quality_shown: This is the choice in force, and nothing was changed.
came_quality_other: The choice came to something this page has no words for.
came_quality_overwritten: Replaced what was edited by hand in {path}:
came_upgrade_cost: {kind} would be fetched again at {preset}, about {size} an hour.
came_upgrade_other: {kind}: this page has no words for how it turned out.
confirm_reapply_prose: lemonfiber writes the preset it has recorded over the quality config, and the changes made to that config by hand are lost. The lines it replaced are listed once it has.
action_upgrade_cost: See what fetching your library again would cost
came_config_pending: {key} would change from {from} to {to}, and nothing has changed yet.
came_config_other: {key} came to something this page has no words for.
came_config_active: Still coming down, and interrupted by it: {name}, over {protocol}, {progress}% done.
came_config_edited: The file holds {found} where lemonfiber last wrote {wrote}.
came_config_proof_rejected: The new credential was turned away, so the old one stays. {detail}
came_config_proof_unreachable: The service could not be reached to prove the new credential, so the old one stays. {detail}
came_config_proof_degraded: The new credential works only in part. {detail}
came_config_proof_other: Proving the new credential came to something this page has no words for.
action_support_save: Save the bundle to this device
doing_reissue_title: Letting somebody set a new password
doing_allow_title: Saying what can be asked for
came_invite_would: An account for {name} would be offered, and nothing has been made yet.
came_invite_waiting: {name} already has an account nobody has signed in to yet, and the offer stands again.
came_invite_joined: {name} already has an account and has signed in to it.
came_invite_reset: {name} can set a new password from the address below.
came_invite_other: What was found where the offer to {name} was going is not something this page has words for.
came_invite_address: Send them {address}. The offer stands for {hours} hours.
came_invite_unlinked: The request service could not be reached, so they cannot ask for anything yet.
came_invite_untried: The request service was not asked about them.
came_invite_link_other: Whether the request service knows them is not something this page has words for.
came_invite_withdrawn: Offers nobody took up in time were withdrawn: {names}
came_invite_suspended: Accounts reset and not claimed again in time were switched off: {names}
confirm_reissue_prose: lemonfiber takes their password off, so they cannot sign in until they set a new one from the address it answers with. An account reset and not claimed again in time is switched off.
action_limits_house: Say what the house may ask for
action_invite_read: See what offering it would make
came_invite_unheld: The request service could not be held to the same limit yet, so what they ask for is not narrowed there.
doing_pair_title: Making a pairing code for a phone
came_pairing_address: The phone reaches this machine at {address}.
came_paused_unsaid: {client} did not say whether it is fetching.
came_paused_none: The stack runs no download client.
doing_bandwidth_title: Declaring how the line is shared
came_update_current: Every service stands on the version this build pins.
came_update_available: Newer versions are pinned than what is running, and nothing has moved yet.
came_update_updated: Everything that had an update took it.
came_update_partial: Some services moved and one did not; the run stopped there.
came_update_failed: Nothing moved, and the run stopped where it did.
came_update_unrecognised: Where the stack stands against its versions is not something this page has words for.
came_update_one_way: {service}: {from} to {to}, {jump}, and nothing walks it back. {because}
came_update_ended_updated: {service} moved from {from} to {to} and is answering again.
came_update_ended_unfetched: {service} stayed on {from}: the newer image was never fetched.
came_update_ended_unstarted: {service} was started on {to} and did not come back.
came_update_ended_unreached: {service} stayed on {from}: the run stopped before reaching it.
came_update_ended_other: How {service} ended is not something this page has words for.
came_update_rollback: {service} can be put back by running its previous version again.
came_update_restore: {service} was started on the newer version, so putting it back means restoring the backup.
came_update_reversal_other: How {service} could be put back is not something this page has words for.
history_prose: Everything lemonfiber changed on this machine, newest first, and how far each change could be put back.
history_when_unread: When, the clock could not say
history_back_whole: It can be put back whole.
history_back_partial: It can be put back only in part.
history_back_other: How far it can be put back is something this page has no word for.
history_alongside: That operation made {count} changes together, and putting this one back takes them all.
action_watch_chosen: Guard the data location while these run
confirm_walk_any_title: Walk something likely to work through?
confirm_walk_prose: lemonfiber searches for it, fetches it and puts it in the library, saying each step. It takes as long as the download does.
action_search: Search the indexers for it now
confirm_host_prose: What it does while it runs: {guarantees}. It is handed to this machine's service manager as {command} and started, and it keeps running when no terminal is open.
confirm_host_prose_forms: What it does while it runs: {guarantees}. It guards {forms}. It is handed to this machine's service manager as {command} and started, and it keeps running when no terminal is open.
confirm_unhost_prose: Its definition is taken off this machine and it stops, so this no longer happens: {guarantees}.
doing_unhost_title: Taking one command off this machine
